title: How does INPE watch the Amazon from space?
hook: One measurement a year, and alerts every day.
summary: PRODES has measured Amazon deforestation once a year since 1988; DETER sends daily alerts to law enforcement.

cardBlocks.text: Brazil’s National Institute for Space Research (INPE) follows the forest with two systems. PRODES uses satellite images to measure, once a year, how much primary forest in the Legal Amazon has been clear-cut, counting areas larger than 6.25 hectares. It provides the country’s official deforestation rate, in a series that starts in 1988.

DETER is faster. It issues daily alerts of deforestation and degradation from cameras on the CBERS-04, CBERS-04A and Amazonia-1 satellites, to guide enforcement on the ground. The alerts are not a monthly deforestation rate: they show a trend.
PRODES has measured Amazon deforestation once a year since 1988; DETER sends daily alerts to guide enforcement.

deepDiveBlocks.text: The PRODES year runs from August to July. For 2019, for example, INPE analysed 229 images of the Legal Amazon and estimated 10,129 km² of clear-cutting between August 2018 and July 2019.
Between August 2025 and July 2026, PRODES recorded 3,335 km² of deforestation in the Amazon, the lowest value in the series that began in 1988.
DETER alerts are open to anyone on INPE’s TerraBrasilis platform.

heroMedia.alt: Diagram of a satellite photographing the forest, with roads and clearings in a fishbone pattern: the data become one measurement a year (PRODES) and daily alerts (DETER).

claims.text: PRODES uses satellite images to map and measure clear-cut areas larger than 6.25 hectares in the Legal Amazon.

support.excerpt: O mapeamento utilizou imagens do satélite Landsat ou similares, para registrar e quantificar as áreas desmatadas maiores que 6,25 hectares.
O PRODES considera como desmatamento a remoção completa da cobertura florestal primária por corte raso, independentemente da futura utilização destas áreas.

claims.text: PRODES is INPE’s yearly monitoring and produces the official deforestation rate, in a series starting in 1988.

support.excerpt: O Prodes é o sistema de monitoramento anual da supressão de vegetação nativa por sensoriamento remoto do Instituto Nacional de Pesquisas Espaciais (INPE), órgão responsável por calcular a taxa oficial de desmatamento no p
o menor valor da série histórica iniciada em 1988, segundo o Inpe.

claims.text: DETER issues daily alerts of clearing, deforestation and degradation from sensors on the CBERS-04, CBERS-04A and Amazonia-1 satellites, to support enforcement.

support.excerpt: O DETER emite avisos diários de supressão, desmatamento e degradação da vegetação nativa, produzidos a partir de imagens dos sensores WFI, a bordo dos satélites CBERS-04, CBERS-04A e Amazônia-1. Seu objetivo é subsidiar as ações de fiscalização e controle realizadas pelos órgãos competentes.

claims.text: DETER alerts are not a monthly deforestation rate; they show a trend.

support.excerpt: os avisos não constituem taxa mensal de desmatamento: eles indicam uma tendência do comportamento do desmatamento
